rationale: Raw source supports a distribution yield around 9.5%-9.84%: the distribution schedule reports a 9.5% annualized yield for the December 2025 distribution, and annual distributions declared per share of 1.91 over NAV per share of 19.83 imply about 9.63%. Source NII per share is 1.88 over the same NAV per share, or about 9.48%; 1.5x that income yield is about 14.22%. The observed flagged distribution-rate value 9.840584972264246 is below this threshold, so the F16 fire is a rule-scope/heuristic false alarm rather than a source data defect.
